name: Somchai Thongchai
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He initially trained as a furniture maker, specializing in intricate wood inlays, but a chance encounter with a racing team needing help repairing damaged bodywork sparked a passion. His keen eye for detail and steady hand proved invaluable, and he quickly transitioned to working with composite materials. He's been a dedicated composite technician ever since, honing his skills through years of practical experience.

Somchai's approach is methodical and pragmatic. He favors proven techniques and reliable materials, believing that consistency is key to performance. While not an innovator, his ability to flawlessly execute complex repairs and fabricate high-quality composite components makes him an invaluable asset to any team. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his unwavering commitment to quality.

What sets Somchai apart is his calm demeanor under pressure. He remains unfazed by tight deadlines and demanding requests, approaching each task with quiet confidence and unwavering focus. He's a steady presence in the garage, a reliable craftsman who consistently delivers exceptional results.

physical.description: Somchai is of medium build, with a weathered face that speaks of years spent working with his hands.

quirks: Always sharpens his tools before starting any task, even if they seem perfectly sharp already.
Drinks jasmine tea throughout the day from a thermos he brings from home.
Meticulously cleans his workspace at the end of each day, leaving it spotless for the next shift.
